title: Calibrating Multi-modal Representations: A Pursuit of Group Robustness without Annotations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) across male and female subgroups on image classification tasks, specifically using the CelebA dataset (predicting hair color) and the CheXpert dataset (predicting illness).
Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) across different racial subgroups (Black, White, and Other) in medical image classification using the CheXpert dataset.

Measuring Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) to evaluate model reliance on spurious environmental cues, tested via the Waterbirds dataset (land vs. water backgrounds) and the MetaShift dataset (indoor vs. outdoor backgrounds).
